Potion, Common

You regain 2d4 + 2 Hit Points when you drink this potion.

Whatever its potency, the potion’s red liquid glimmers when agitated.

Potion, Uncommon

You regain 4d4 + 4 Hit Points when you drink this potion.

Whatever its potency, the potion’s red liquid glimmers when agitated.

Potion, Rare

You regain 8d4 + 8 Hit Points when you drink this potion.

Whatever its potency, the potion’s red liquid glimmers when agitated.

Potion, Rare

The clear, red liquid has tiny bubbles of light in it.

When you drink this potion, you are cured of all magical contagions. In addition, the following conditions end on you: &Reference[Blinded], &Reference[Deafened], &Reference[Paralyzed], and &Reference[Poisoned].
As a Bonus Action, you can drink a vial of Antitoxin to gain Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition for 1 hour.

Potion, Common

When you drink this potion, you gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed for 1 hour. During this time, you have Advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb.

This potion is separated into brown, silver, and gray layers resembling bands of stone. Shaking the bottle fails to mix the colors.

Foundry Note

The Climber Active Effect can be used for tracking but can not automate the effects.

Potion, Common

When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplComprehend]{Comprehend Languages} spell for 1 hour.

This potion’s liquid is a clear concoction with bits of salt and soot swirling in it.

Potion, Uncommon

You can breathe underwater for 24 hours after drinking this potion.

This potion’s cloudy green fluid smells of the sea and has a jellyfish-like bubble floating in it.

Foundry Note

The Water Breather Active Effect can be used for tracking.

Potion, Uncommon

When you drink this potion, you can cast the level 3 version of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplAnimalFrie]{Animal Friendship} spell (save DC 13).

Agitating this potion’s muddy liquid brings little bits into view: a fish scale, a hummingbird feather, a cat claw, or a squirrel hair.

Potion, Uncommon

When you drink this potion, you gain the “enlarge” effect of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplEnlargeRed]{Enlarge/Reduce} spell for 10 minutes (no Concentration required).

The red in the potion’s liquid continuously expands from a tiny bead to color the clear liquid around it and then contracts. Shaking the bottle fails to interrupt this process.

Potion, Uncommon

One vial of this oil can cover one Medium or smaller creature, along with the equipment it’s wearing and carrying (one additional vial is required for each size category above Medium). Applying the oil takes 10 minutes. The affected creature then gains the effect of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplFreedomofM]{Freedom of Movement} spell for 8 hours.

Alternatively, the oil can be poured on the ground as a Magic action, where it covers a 10-foot square, duplicating the effect of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplGrease0000]{Grease} spell in that area for 8 hours.

This sticky, black unguent is thick and heavy, but it flows quickly when poured.

After you drink this potion, each Unarmed Strike you make deals an extra 1d6 Force damage on a hit. This effect lasts 10 minutes.

This potion is a thick green fluid that tastes like spinach.

Potion, Uncommon

When you drink this potion, your Strength score changes for 1 hour to 21. The type of giant determines the score. The potion has no effect on you if your Strength is equal to or greater than that score.

This potion’s transparent liquid has floating in it a sliver of light resembling a giant’s fingernail.

Potion, Rare

When you drink this potion, you gain 10 Temporary Hit Points that last for 1 hour. For the same duration, you are under the effect of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplBless00000]{Bless} spell (no Concentration required).

This potion’s blue liquid bubbles and steams as if boiling.

description.value:
A stoppered clay vial of bitter green cordial, brewed behind the counter and sealed by hand. The label is written in Selma's tidy, careful hand: “One swallow at bedtime.”

A swallow brings deep and dreamless sleep — a common enough remedy in a town where the nights are long and the forest is close.

Potion, Uncommon

When you drink this potion, you have Resistance to Poison damage for 1 hour.

A disc of solid gold the width of a spread hand, prised out of the stone plinth it was set into. Blank on both faces — no stamp, no engraving, nothing to read.

One spot on the upper face is worn to a soft dull sheen, the size and shape of a palm, and the metal there is very slightly hollowed. A great many hands, over a great many years, all resting in exactly the same place.

items.name: Violet Stone from the Black Basin

description.value:
A rough crystal the size of a hen's egg, lifted from the bottom of the basin, out from under the veiled woman's cupped hands. It is violet at one end and very nearly black at the other.

It is dry the moment it leaves the water. Close your fist around it and the seams between your fingers glow, faintly, the way a coal does when it is nearly out.

items.name: Gilt-Framed Portrait of a Smiling Merchant

description.value:
A competent portrait in a gilt frame worth more than the sitter: a well-dressed man in his study, green waistcoat, gold signet ring on his right hand, one hand on a sword he has never drawn. He is posing, and smiling like a man who has done well for himself.

A brass plate on the frame reads: "A gift, with gratitude, for my best customers — confident you would never bite the hand that feeds you." No name. Nobody the party recognizes.

items.name: Bag of Gold Tesserae, Prised Loose

description.value:
Two double handfuls of gold mosaic tile, chiselled up out of the floor of the lower hall — the rays, mostly. The centers of both suns were already gone long before anyone got here, and the chisel marks there are old.

Every piece is still backed with grey mortar. It is not coin, and it will have to be weighed and melted before it is.

items.name: Rack of Stoppered Jars, Cave-Bloom Draught

description.value:
A carrying rack of twelve small jars off the workbench in the glowing cave, each one stoppered and sealed with wax, each holding two fingers of a syrup the colour of the caps it was pressed out of.

The smell comes through the wax anyway — sweet, and thick, and after a moment your eyes want to close. An apothecary would know what to do with this. An apothecary would also want to know where it came from.

Charts off the shelves in the room with the turning sphere: the night sky in silver ink on black paper, drawn to a standard of care that costs money. Ribbons mark the pages someone went back to most.

The sun is not on any of them. Not left off awkwardly — simply not there, and the charts are complete without it.

items.name: Bolt of Sanctuary Velvet, Deep Purple

description.value:
Bench-covering cut off the sanctuary benches and rolled: heavy velvet in a purple so deep it reads black indoors, and is purple after all the moment it goes out into daylight.

Barely worn. Whoever kept this place kept the cloth brushed.

data.description: Selma's Apothecary — potions, tonics, and remedies
